Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Vinayak Pant, Advocate i/b Mr. D.S. 
Patni, Senior Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for respondent 
no.1.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate for respondent
nos.4 & 5.
These are three connected matters. In Writ 
Petition (M/S) No.3283 of 2017 the counsel for the 
petitioner seeks an adjournment on account of the 
non-availability of the arguing counsel. But,
looking to the order sheet, this Court is hesitant to 
grant the adjournment. 
But in the wider interest of justice it is being 
adjourned by way of last opportunity and the writ 
petition is directed to be listed in the week 
commencing 28.2.2022. 
In the connected matter, that is Writ Petition 
(M/S) No.16 of 2018, the Coordinate Bench of this 
Court by an order of 15.01.2021, directed the 
respondents to decide the representation of the 
petitioner. 
It has been informed by the counsel for the 
petitioner that the said representation has already 
been rejected. 
Mr. M.C. Pant, counsel for the petitioner in 
WPMS No.16 of 2018, may file his amendment 
application if so advised challenging the order of 
rejection of his representation. 
List these writ petitions in the week 
commencing 28.02.2022.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 03.01.2022
Arti

WPMS No. 3283 of 2017
WPMS No. 516 of 2018 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate, for the petitioners. 
Mr. D.S. Patni, Senior Advocate, assisted by 
Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, Advocate, for the 
respondents. 
These are the bunch of three Writ Petitions, 
in which, the respondent No.1 has filed the counter 
affidavit to the amended Writ Petition through IA 
No. 39 of 2022. 
The counter affidavit filed by respondent 
No.1 would stand allowed. 
The counter affidavit is taken on record. 
The learned counsel for the petitioners 
submits that he does not propose to file any 
rejoinder to the counter affidavit filed by 
respondent No.1 to the amended Writ Petition. 
The Writ Petitions are directed to be listed 
under the head of hearing in the week commencing 
5th September, 2022. 
In the meantime, the other respondents, if so 
advised, may exchange their pleadings.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 07.07.2022 Shiv
